name: QR Code
description: A corner widget that opens the first QR code on tap, plus up to four QR codes (URL, text or Wi-Fi credentials) that open through actions bindable to gestures, the kiosk drawer or Home Assistant buttons.
author: shin-01

settings.title: Show corner widget
settings.description: Keep the tappable widget, which opens the first QR code, in a display corner.

settings.title: Corner
settings.description: Where the widget sits.

settings.title: Widget icon
settings.description: The icon on the corner widget.

settings.title: QR size
settings.description: The size of the QR code in the full screen card.

settings.title: Title
settings.description: The label on the corner widget and the heading of this QR's card.

settings.title: Content type
settings.description: What this QR code encodes.

settings.title: Network name (SSID)
settings.description: The Wi-Fi network the QR code joins.

settings.title: Security
settings.description: The network's security type.

settings.title: Password
settings.description: The Wi-Fi password, masked in the Plugin Manager and Remote Admin.

settings.title: URL
settings.description: The link the QR code opens, such as https://www.kiosksatellite.com/

settings.title: Text
settings.description: Any text the QR code carries.
